project_plan.project_name: College Issue Reporting and Management System
project_plan.project_summary: A web application enabling students to report campus issues, track status, vote on reports, and allowing administrators to manage, assign, and resolve these issues through a unified dashboard.

tasks.title: Project Setup & Planning
tasks.description: Initialize Git repository, configure project structure, set up CI pipeline and documentation framework.

tasks.title: Database Design
tasks.description: Design relational schema for users, issues, votes, assignments, and status tracking using PostgreSQL.

tasks.title: Backend API Development - Core Endpoints
tasks.description: Implement FastAPI services for issue creation, retrieval, voting, status updates, and admin assignment logic.

tasks.title: Frontend UI Mockup & Component Library
tasks.description: Set up React project, create reusable UI components and pages with mock data for issue reporting and tracking.

tasks.title: Frontend Integration with API
tasks.description: Connect React components to backend FastAPI endpoints, implement authentication, voting, and real‑time status updates.

tasks.title: Frontend Integration with Backend API
tasks.description: Connect React UI components to prepared API endpoints. Handle data fetching, error handling, and UI state.

tasks.title: Backend Integration Support
tasks.description: Prepare and verify FastAPI endpoint contracts and consistent responses for frontend integration.

tasks.title: Automated Testing
tasks.description: Create unit and integration tests for backend services and frontend components, set up test runners and coverage reports.

tasks.title: Deployment & Containerization
tasks.description: Dockerize backend and frontend, configure CI/CD pipelines for automated builds and deployment to cloud environment.

tasks.title: Documentation & User Guide
tasks.description: Write comprehensive project documentation, API reference, and end‑user guide for reporting and admin workflows.

risks: Scope creep leading to additional feature requests
Delayed backend‑frontend integration due to mismatched API contracts

subtasks.title: Initialize Git repository and configure remote
subtasks.description: Create a new Git repository, add .gitignore, set up main branch, and push to the remote hosting service (e.g., GitHub or GitLab).

subtasks.title: Define project directory structure
subtasks.description: Create top‑level folders (src, tests, docs, scripts, config) and scaffold basic placeholder files to enforce a consistent layout.

subtasks.title: Set up continuous integration pipeline
subtasks.description: Configure a CI workflow (GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, or similar) to run linting, unit tests, and build checks on each push/PR.

subtasks.title: Create initial documentation framework
subtasks.description: Add a README template, CONTRIBUTING guide, and a docs folder with a basic MkDocs/Sphinx configuration.

subtasks.title: Establish coding standards and pre‑commit hooks
subtasks.description: Select linting/formatting tools (e.g., ESLint, Black), add configuration files, and install pre‑commit hooks to enforce standards automatically.

subtasks.title: Gather Requirements and Define Entities
subtasks.description: Review project specifications to identify all required entities (users, issues, votes, assignments, status tracking) and their attributes. Document relationships and constraints.

subtasks.title: Create ER Diagram and Normalize Schema
subtasks.description: Draw an Entity‑Relationship diagram, apply normalization (up to 3NF) to eliminate redundancy, and decide primary/foreign keys for each table.

subtasks.title: Write PostgreSQL DDL Scripts
subtasks.description: Translate the normalized model into CREATE TABLE statements, including data types, constraints, indexes, and default values for timestamps.

subtasks.title: Implement Referential Integrity and Triggers
subtasks.description: Add foreign key constraints, ON DELETE/UPDATE actions, and write necessary triggers (e.g., for status change audit logs).

subtasks.title: Create Sample Data and Test Queries
subtasks.description: Populate tables with representative seed data and run SELECT/INSERT/UPDATE tests to verify relationships, indexing, and performance.

subtasks.title: Document Schema and Migration Plan
subtasks.description: Produce a concise schema documentation (tables, columns, relationships) and outline a migration strategy using tools like Flyway or Liquibase.

subtasks.title: Design API schema and data models
subtasks.description: Define Pydantic models for Issue, Vote, Status, and AdminAssignment. Create SQLAlchemy ORM models and migration scripts. Document request/response schemas.

subtasks.title: Implement issue creation endpoint
subtasks.description: Build POST /issues endpoint with validation, authentication, and database insertion. Return created issue with ID and timestamps.

subtasks.title: Implement issue retrieval endpoints
subtasks.description: Create GET /issues (list with filters) and GET /issues/{id} endpoints. Include pagination, sorting, and eager loading of related votes and status.

subtasks.title: Implement voting and status update logic
subtasks.description: Add POST /issues/{id}/vote and PATCH /issues/{id}/status endpoints. Enforce business rules (one vote per user, valid status transitions) and emit appropriate responses.

subtasks.title: Implement admin assignment endpoint
subtasks.description: Create POST /issues/{id}/assign-admin endpoint. Validate admin role, update assignment field, and send notification hook.

subtasks.title: Write unit and integration tests
subtasks.description: Develop pytest suites covering all core endpoints, edge cases, and error handling. Use TestClient and a temporary SQLite DB.

subtasks.title: Documentation and OpenAPI refinement
subtasks.description: Add detailed docstrings, update FastAPI automatic OpenAPI spec, and generate README usage examples for each endpoint.

subtasks.title: Initialize React Project and Tooling
subtasks.description: Set up a new React application using Create React App or Vite, configure TypeScript, ESLint, Prettier, and install necessary UI libraries (e.g., styled-components or Tailwind). Commit initial project structure to version control.

subtasks.title: Design Component Architecture & Style Guide
subtasks.description: Define a component hierarchy (atoms, molecules, organisms) and create a style guide covering colors, typography, spacing, and interaction states. Document the guidelines in a markdown file or Storybook.

subtasks.title: Build Core Reusable UI Components
subtasks.description: Develop reusable components such as Button, Input, Select, Modal, Card, and Notification. Ensure each component supports props for customization and includes basic unit tests.

subtasks.title: Create Issue Reporting Page Mockup
subtasks.description: Assemble the core components to build a mock Issue Reporting page with fields for title, description, priority, and attachment upload. Populate the page with static mock data and ensure responsive layout.

subtasks.title: Create Issue Tracking Dashboard Mockup
subtasks.description: Construct a mock Issue Tracking dashboard using tables, filters, and status badges. Use mock data to demonstrate sorting, pagination, and status updates.

subtasks.title: Integrate Components into Storybook
subtasks.description: Add all created components and page mockups to Storybook for visual testing and documentation. Verify that each story reflects different states and variants.

subtasks.title: Set up API service layer
subtasks.description: Create a reusable API client using Axios or Fetch, configure base URL, error handling, and token injection for authentication.

subtasks.title: Implement authentication flow
subtasks.description: Integrate login, logout, and token refresh UI components with FastAPI auth endpoints; store JWT securely and protect routes.

subtasks.title: Connect voting component to backend
subtasks.description: Wire up the React voting UI to POST/GET voting endpoints, handle optimistic UI updates, and display vote counts.

subtasks.title: Add real‑time status updates
subtasks.description: Integrate WebSocket (or Server‑Sent Events) client to receive live status changes from FastAPI and update the UI accordingly.

subtasks.title: Error handling & user feedback
subtasks.description: Implement global error handling, loading spinners, and toast notifications for API failures and success messages.

subtasks.title: Connect frontend API client
subtasks.description: Configure API calls and request handling for the required endpoints.

subtasks.title: Implement response and error handling
subtasks.description: Handle API responses, loading states, and errors in React components.

subtasks.title: Verify frontend integration
subtasks.description: Test the integrated UI flows against the prepared backend endpoints.

subtasks.title: Verify API contracts
subtasks.description: Confirm request fields, response formats, and endpoint behavior.

subtasks.title: Standardize backend responses
subtasks.description: Check validation and consistent success and error responses.

subtasks.title: Verify integration readiness
subtasks.description: Run endpoint checks and document integration requirements.

subtasks.title: Define testing strategy and select frameworks
subtasks.description: Document the overall testing approach, decide on unit testing frameworks (e.g., Jest for frontend, pytest for backend) and integration testing tools (e.g., Cypress, SuperTest). Create a shared configuration repository and set up CI integration guidelines.

subtasks.title: Implement backend unit tests
subtasks.description: Write unit tests for all backend service functions, covering business logic, data validation, and error handling. Use mocking for external dependencies and achieve at least 70% code coverage.

subtasks.title: Implement frontend component tests
subtasks.description: Create unit tests for React/Vue components using the chosen framework. Test props handling, state changes, and rendering outcomes. Include snapshot tests where appropriate.

subtasks.title: Set up integration/end‑to‑end test suite
subtasks.description: Configure integration tests that exercise API endpoints and UI flows together. Use tools like Cypress or Playwright to simulate user interactions and verify full stack behavior.

subtasks.title: Configure test runners and coverage reporting
subtasks.description: Integrate test runners into the build pipeline, generate coverage reports (e.g., Istanbul/Codecov), and enforce minimum coverage thresholds in CI.

subtasks.title: Document testing guidelines and onboarding
subtasks.description: Write concise documentation on how to run tests locally, interpret coverage reports, and add new tests. Include troubleshooting tips and a checklist for code reviews.

subtasks.title: Create Dockerfiles for Backend and Frontend
subtasks.description: Write optimized Dockerfiles for the backend (including runtime, dependencies, and environment variables) and the frontend (build stage and production server). Test image builds locally.

subtasks.title: Set Up Docker Compose for Local Development
subtasks.description: Define a docker-compose.yml that orchestrates backend, frontend, and any supporting services (e.g., database, cache). Verify multi‑container startup and inter‑service networking.

subtasks.title: Configure CI Pipeline for Image Build & Test
subtasks.description: Add CI steps (GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, etc.) to build Docker images on each push, run unit/integration tests inside containers, and push successful images to a container registry.

subtasks.title: Create CD Pipeline for Automated Deployment
subtasks.description: Implement CD workflow that pulls images from the registry, applies infrastructure-as-code (e.g., Terraform or CloudFormation), and deploys to the target cloud environment (AWS/EKS, GCP/GKE, or Azure AKS). Include health checks and rollback strategy.

subtasks.title: Configure Environment Variables & Secrets Management
subtasks.description: Set up secure handling of environment-specific variables and secrets (using cloud secret manager or CI secret stores) and ensure they are injected into containers at runtime.

subtasks.title: Documentation & Knowledge Transfer
subtasks.description: Document Dockerfile rationale, compose configuration, CI/CD pipeline definitions, and deployment steps. Provide a quick‑start guide for developers and ops teams.

subtasks.title: Outline Documentation Structure
subtasks.description: Create a detailed outline covering project overview, architecture, API reference, reporting workflow, admin workflow, and end‑user guide sections. Identify required diagrams and code snippets.

subtasks.title: Write API Reference
subtasks.description: Document each public endpoint, request/response schemas, authentication, error codes, and usage examples. Generate Swagger/OpenAPI spec and embed it in the docs.

subtasks.title: Create Reporting Workflow Guide
subtasks.description: Produce step‑by‑step instructions for end users to generate, filter, and export reports. Include screenshots, best‑practice tips, and troubleshooting FAQ.

subtasks.title: Create Admin Workflow Guide
subtasks.description: Document admin tasks such as user management, permission configuration, system settings, and audit log review. Provide role‑based examples and security considerations.

subtasks.title: Assemble End‑User Guide
subtasks.description: Combine reporting and admin sections into a cohesive user guide, add a quick‑start tutorial, glossary, and index. Ensure consistent style and formatting.

subtasks.title: Review, Edit, and Publish
subtasks.description: Perform peer review, incorporate feedback, proofread for clarity, and publish documentation to the project wiki/website with proper versioning.

risk_analysis.project_name: College Issue Reporting and Management System

risks.title: Scope Creep and Uncontrolled Feature Additions
risks.description: Stakeholders may request additional functionalities (e.g., mobile app, analytics dashboards) after the initial plan, stretching the 182‑hour estimate and delaying delivery.
risks.mitigation: Establish a formal change control process: any new feature must be documented, impact‑analyzed, and approved by the project sponsor. Prioritize features in a product backlog and schedule them for future releases.

risks.title: Backend‑Frontend Integration Delays due to API Contract Mismatch
risks.description: Task 5 depends on both backend (Task 3) and frontend (Task 4). If the API endpoints, request/response schemas, or authentication mechanisms differ from what the frontend expects, integration will stall, consuming extra time beyond the allocated 30 hours.
risks.mitigation: Develop an OpenAPI specification during Task 2 and share it with the frontend team. Use contract‑testing tools (e.g., Schemathesis, Postman) to validate implementations continuously. Schedule a joint integration checkpoint after Task 3 is 80% complete.

risks.title: Insufficient Automated Testing Leading to Production Bugs
risks.description: Task 7 (Automated Testing) is scheduled after core development and integration. If test coverage is low, defects may surface post‑deployment, increasing support effort and harming user trust.
risks.mitigation: Adopt test‑driven development for new backend endpoints and frontend components. Define minimum coverage thresholds (e.g., 70% backend, 60% frontend) and enforce them via CI pipelines. Allocate a small portion of earlier tasks for writing tests alongside feature code.

risks.title: Deployment Environment Incompatibilities
risks.description: Task 8 involves Dockerizing and deploying to a cloud environment. Differences between local development containers and the target cloud platform (e.g., networking, environment variables, database connections) can cause deployment failures close to the deadline.
risks.mitigation: Set up a staging environment that mirrors production early in the CI/CD pipeline. Use infrastructure‑as‑code (e.g., Terraform) to provision resources consistently. Perform a dry‑run deployment during Task 7 to catch issues early.

risks.title: Low User Adoption and Limited Feedback
risks.description: If students and staff do not adopt the system, the project may not deliver its intended value, and future enhancements will lack real‑world data.
risks.mitigation: Plan a pilot rollout with a small campus cohort, gather usability metrics, and incorporate feedback before full launch. Provide training sessions and promotional materials to raise awareness.

recommendations: Adopt a lightweight Agile sprint cadence (2‑week sprints) with a clear Definition of Done for each task to surface delays early.
Create a detailed API specification (OpenAPI/Swagger) before backend development and lock it down with the frontend team to avoid contract mismatches.
Allocate a 10‑15% time buffer on critical path tasks (Database Design, Backend API Development, Frontend Integration) to absorb unforeseen complexity.
Implement automated testing (unit, integration, end‑to‑end) early; aim for at least 70% coverage before the testing phase begins.
Engage a pilot group of students and campus staff during the UI mockup stage to validate usability and gather early adoption feedback.

schedule.project_name: College Issue Reporting and Management System
scheduling_notes: Frontend UI work (task 4) runs in parallel with backend development (task 3) after initial setup
Integration tasks (5 and 6) start together once both backend core and UI components are ready, creating a parallel workload
Testing (task 7) waits for both integration streams, becoming the bottleneck before deployment
Documentation (task 9) proceeds alongside testing, finishing before final deployment

resource_allocation.project_name: College Issue Reporting and Management System

assignments.notes: Initial setup is lightweight; can be handled by the Project Manager or a senior Full‑Stack Engineer with DevOps experience. Allocate 1‑2 days; ensure repository standards and CI pipeline are documented for downstream teams.
Database schema design should be owned by a Backend Developer. Pair with the Project Manager for requirements validation. Estimated 2 full days; keep schema versioned for CI.
Core API work is a high‑priority block. One Backend Developer can complete it in ~3 days. Ensure OpenAPI spec is generated for frontend consumption.
Create component library and mock pages. A Frontend Developer can finish in ~2.5 days. Coordinate with Backend Developer on data shapes.
Integration requires both frontend and backend knowledge. Assign a Full‑Stack Engineer to bridge gaps; allocate 4‑5 days. Include unit tests for API calls.
Integrate React UI components with the prepared API endpoints.
Verify FastAPI endpoint contracts and response consistency.
QA Engineer writes unit and integration tests for both backend and frontend, and configures coverage. Should work closely with developers; allocate ~3 days.
Containerization and pipeline automation are DevOps responsibilities. One DevOps Engineer can finish in ~2.5 days, ensuring rollback strategy and environment parity.
Technical Writer produces API docs, user guide, and onboarding material. Work can start after integration (tasks 5 & 6) are stable; allocate 1.5 days.

progress_report.project_name: College Issue Reporting and Management System
recommendations: Continue updating task status and actual hours regularly.

recommendations.project_name: College Issue Reporting and Management System

recommendations.title: Kick‑off Sprint Planning & Definition of Done
recommendations.description: Run a 2‑week sprint planning workshop to break each high‑priority task into sub‑tasks, assign owners, and define a clear Definition of Done (DoD) that includes unit tests, documentation, and code review. Capture the sprint backlog in a shared board (e.g., GitHub Projects) and schedule daily stand‑ups.
recommendations.expected_benefit: Creates visibility into progress, surfaces blockers early, and aligns the team on quality criteria, reducing the chance of hidden delays and scope creep.

recommendations.title: Create & Lock Down an OpenAPI Specification Before Development
recommendations.description: During Task 2 (Database Design), draft a complete OpenAPI/Swagger spec for all backend endpoints, including request/response schemas, authentication, and error codes. Share the spec with the frontend team, generate client stubs, and enforce contract testing (e.g., Schemathesis) as part of the CI pipeline.
recommendations.expected_benefit: Eliminates the high‑severity risk of backend‑frontend integration delays by ensuring both sides work against a single source of truth, cutting rework and saving up to 20% of integration time.

recommendations.title: Introduce Test‑Driven Development (TDD) for Core Features
recommendations.description: For each new endpoint (Task 3) and UI component (Task 4/5), write failing unit tests first, then implement the code to pass them. Enforce a minimum coverage threshold (70% backend, 60% frontend) via CI and treat coverage failures as blockers.
recommendations.expected_benefit: Addresses the medium‑severity risk of insufficient testing, catches defects early, and reduces post‑deployment bugs, leading to higher user confidence and lower support effort.

recommendations.title: Set Up a Staging Environment Mirroring Production
recommendations.description: Configure a Docker‑based staging cluster that replicates the target cloud environment (network, env vars, DB). Deploy the application after Task 7 (Automated Testing) to this stage, run end‑to‑end smoke tests, and validate deployment scripts before the final production rollout.
recommendations.expected_benefit: Mitigates the medium‑severity deployment incompatibility risk, ensures a smooth final deployment, and provides a safe space for pilot users to test the system.

recommendations.title: Pilot Rollout with Feedback Loop
recommendations.description: Select a small cohort of students and staff to use the UI mockups (Task 4) and early builds. Collect usability metrics, issue reports, and adoption data via a short survey. Incorporate feedback into the backlog before full launch.
recommendations.expected_benefit: Reduces the low‑severity risk of low user adoption by validating the product with real users early, allowing adjustments that improve acceptance and provide actionable data for future releases.

recommendations.summary: Implement structured sprint planning, lock down an API contract, adopt TDD, provision a staging environment, and run a pilot with feedback. These actions directly address the highest risks—scope creep, integration mismatches, testing gaps, and deployment issues—while keeping the project on schedule and improving overall quality.
